## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2015-03-23: Form-of TRA (SLP Exchanges) filed as Exhibit 10.8 to S-1/A
- 2015-04-15: Virtu Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement (SLP Exchanges) filed at 85% with Silver Lake Partners-affiliated holders of retained Virtu Financial LLC Units, covering Section 754 basis step-ups from their future post-IPO exchanges plus imputed interest; Section 3.03(b) cross-coordinates payments with the parallel non-SLP-Exchanges and Mergers TRAs (10-Q Exhibit 10.7)

## Explanation

Virtu Financial, Inc. executed three parallel Tax Receivable Agreements at its April 15, 2015 Up-C IPO; this contract (the "SLP Exchanges" TRA) covers the Silver Lake Partners-affiliated holders that retained their Virtu Financial LLC Units at IPO and will exchange them post-IPO (rather than delivering them via merger at close, which is what the parallel Mergers TRA covers). It pays 85% of net cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups arising from future exchanges of their LLC Units plus imputed interest, structurally mirroring the non-SLP-Exchanges TRA but with a different beneficiary group. Section 3.03(b) pro-rata-coordinates payments across all three Virtu TRAs so they function as one economic obligation administered as three legal instruments. No on-EDGAR amendment, restatement, waiver, or termination has been filed; the contract remains in force as of FY2025 within the aggregate $181.9M Virtu TRA liability. See `contract_log.md` for the cross-contract reasoning and the parallel-TRA structure.
